title: Self-Deadlock via RCU Nesting and synchronize_rcu
pattern: Invoking a synchronous grace-period wait (like `synchronize_rcu`) from inside an RCU read-side critical section.
why_bad: `synchronize_rcu` blocks until all pre-existing RCU read-side critical sections complete. Because it is invoked inside an active RCU reader, it waits for itself to unlock, resulting in a permanent self-deadlock.
detection: Control flow path demonstrating an active RCU read-side critical section scope enclosing a synchronous grace-period API call.
counterexample: Using asynchronous callback scheduling (`call_rcu`) which registers a callback and returns immediately without blocking the reader.
source: Paul McKenney Quick Quiz 9.64, Quick Quiz B.26
